verdict.rationale: Vapi's API/SDK covers assistant, phone number, and call management, backed by a full CLI (vapi-docs-2 through 4, 27, 31-32, verified live in vapi-probe-rt-1) and an official MCP server exposing the same operations for external agents (vapi-docs-5,33, confirmed live and auth-gated in vapi-probe-rt-2). Dashboard-only conveniences like Voice Library browsing/preview remain UI-centric, though voice IDs and custom voices can be set via API (vapi-docs-9,24,26,35). Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every dashboard-only feature (e.g., visual Voice Library browsing, HIPAA toggle) has a full API equivalent, and independent (non-vendor) verification of full UI/API parity.
